# Cirth v0.8.3

Cirth v0.8.3 is a bug-fix release: it stops rendering a duplicate calendar
icon on Firefox date/time inputs, fixes the coral and cobalt presets
falling back to a light background under system dark mode, and stops a
nested dropdown's close-catcher from blocking clicks on its parent
dropdown's own menu items. No breaking changes.

## Fixed

- **Date/time inputs no longer show two calendar icons on Firefox**
  (gh#79) — the Firefox-only reset that hid our custom icon relied on
  `@-moz-document url-prefix()`, which Firefox restricted to
  `userContent.css`/`userChrome.css` since version 59 and silently
  ignores in an author stylesheet, so the icon it was meant to hide kept
  rendering next to Firefox's own native one. Replaced with a real
  feature-detection query.
- **Coral and cobalt presets kept a light background in system dark
  mode** (gh#81) — both presets left their dark-mode background tokens
  undeclared, relying on cascade fallthrough from the base theme that a
  CSS specificity tie broke in the preset's favor. Each preset now
  declares its own dark canvas explicitly.
- **A dropdown nested inside another open dropdown could block clicks
  on the outer menu's own items** (gh#7) — its `position: fixed`
  close-catcher painted above the outer menu's non-positioned items
  regardless of z-index or DOM order. Only the outermost open dropdown
  renders a close-catcher now.

## Changed

- Visual regression now runs across Firefox and WebKit in addition to
  Chromium — this is what would have caught the two rendering bugs above
  automatically. Doesn't touch the published package.

See the [Changelog](https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#083---2026-08-12)
for the complete, itemized list.
